svg.title: Arena Dusk style tile, pass 2c
svg.text: Style tile - pass 2c (reconciled) - 720 px design width
Deep navy and teal, one warm coral for the single go action.
Light comes from above; depth comes from three surfaces.
Large-text mode: same px on a 626 px canvas (x1.15). Floor 24 px; tile captions are annotation.

g.text: Pick sheet (E3): one full-width 96 px button for the phase, never both
Ban phase: outlined, warning icon, no fill colour (WARN rim 3.7 to 4.9:1 on the sheet)
Pick phase: the one coral action on the screen (play kind, glow)
Readable at 96, 64 and 48 px: at 64 and below only silhouette and ring are used
Hash of the id picks them, then a clash check
keeps every club in a league unique.
Ink letter on the colour: 5.2:1 or better.
Rim, gloss and shadow come from one recipe.
Drawn from Hollowmere: left arc = Top, vertical causeway = Mid, right arc = Bot. 48 px grid.
Same set at 64 px, 48 px (role colour) and 32 px (colour removed: shape only)
Replaces the 35 degree stripe. Tile 144 x 192 px, never under text.
PORTRAITS AT 48 PX: RING PLUS CORNER GLYPH
Rule: portraits of 56 px or less carry the role glyph in a 26 px chip, lower right.
You = teal circle, them = coral flat-top hexagon, solid fill, letter inside. Plates = structures.
Actual size, 40 px: you (top row), them (bottom row)
Tokens on each surface (non-text contrast, needs 3:1): teal / coral
Neutral: camps in lime (Jungle ring colour), early objective gold, late objective pale
Versus bar, side flags, and a map label (24 px, outlined)
word + flag, Home and draft board only
Window: player half, y 0.38 to 1.00 of the arena. Tokens 96 px; corner = rating, status icon.
10 CLUB COLOUR ON HOME: 10 PERCENT WASH
Home hero = page gradient + club colour at 10 percent. Badge full colour. Chrome teal and coral.
Needs attention: UI-PASS-2 structure (swipe row, 96 px), bible colour (gold rail, no gold fill)
Original work: colours, shapes and silhouettes drawn in code for this game.
Type: Barlow Semi Condensed (SIL OFL 1.1), rendered from the real font files.
